# KiCad library files used in tests

These files are taken unchanged from the KiCad libraries, release 9.0.0 (`sample.kicad_sym` is a handful of symbols
copied out of `Device`, `Transistor_BJT`, `74xx` and `power`):

- https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-symbols
- https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints

They are the work of the KiCad librarians and contributors, licensed CC-BY-SA 4.0 with an exception that lets you use
them in your own designs without that licence applying to the design: https://www.kicad.org/libraries/license/

They are here only so the readers are tested against real files.
